title: Lightweight structural truss optimization
summary: Discrete sizing and topology search with frozen linear truss models and independent verification; research pilot, donor intake paused.

review.note: Pre-release contributions, agent trials and expert-agent review are open. Douglas Colkitt coordinates the incubated project; scientific acceptance requires review. No fixed review throughput or completed expert signoff is implied. See PARTICIPATION.md.

credit.policy: Record consenting contributors and reviewers in CONTRIBUTORS.md and result packages; cite benchmark authors; disclose AI assistance; no automatic paper authorship.

requirements.note: Python >=3.12 with pinned requirements; no GPU. Tested on macOS arm64/Python 3.14.
